subject: Re: RapidProof POC — scope adjustment vs top-up credit
messages:
From: Alex Boone <alex.boone@ventris.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ventris Procurement <procurement@ventris.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RapidProof POC — running short on runway, options?

Hi Irene,

Quick one — our RapidProof engineering team ran through the usage numbers this morning and we’re tracking to exceed the trial compute bucket by next Wednesday (Nov 4). We still have two key evaluation items left: (1) steady-state latencies on 8k contexts and (2) a routing failure mode test.

Procurement is asking whether Redwood can either:
- provide a short credit top-up to cover the extra 10k tokens, or
- allow us to scope down the remaining tests (skip the routing stress test) and extend the trial window by two weeks to run just the latency benchmarks.

We’re open to either — cost/commitment is the deciding factor for Finance. Can you advise what you’d prefer from Redwood and a simple cost comparison?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Boone
Head of ML Platforms | Ventris Analytics
alex.boone@ventris.ai

Attachments: none
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Boone <alex.boone@ventris.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RapidProof POC — running short on runway, options?

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up. Sorry to hear you’re tight on runway. Two quick paths we typically offer for short, time-boxed evaluations:

Option A — Credit top-up
- One-off credit applied to the trial account to cover additional token consumption.
- Typical size for what you described: a 10k-token top-up (~$950 at current list), we can provide a 15% promotional credit on top for partner trials.
- No changes to the POC scope.

Option B — Scope reduction + window extension
- Gate a non-blocking routing-failure stress test and extend the trial by 14 days for latency-only runs.
- We can discount the extended window by reducing the required compute allocation (30% lower billable capacity for the gated period).
- Requires an SOW amendment to reflect altered acceptance criteria.

I’m looping in Marissa (CS lead) to weigh the operational impact and David (SE) to confirm the gating work. If Procurement prefers a PO route we can draft a short SOW amendment and send it back for signature.

Which direction does Ventris prefer — predictable credit or scope+time? Happy to get a one-page SOW drafted by EOD Wednesday.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

Attachments: none
From: Ventris Procurement <procurement@ventris.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Boone <alex.boone@ventris.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RapidProof POC — running short on runway, options?

Hi Irene — procurement here. For audit/PO reasons Finance prefers a single-line cost adjustment rather than changing acceptance criteria mid-trial. Our preference is Option A (credit top-up) unless Redwood can provide a short amendment with firm acceptance criteria and a vendor-signed SOW we can PO against.

If you can provide both a credit figure and a short SOW (1 page) for the scope-adjust option we can evaluate internally. Otherwise we’ll prepare a PO for the credit.

Thanks — please include the cost in USD and the invoice flow (net30).

Regards,
Ventris Procurement
procurement@ventris.ai

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ventris Procurement <procurement@ventris.ai>, Alex Boone <alex.boone@ventris.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RapidProof POC — running short on runway, options?

Hi team — quick operational readout and two concrete proposals for Procurement to choose from. David and I reviewed the remaining engineering work: gating the routing stress test is straightforward (feature-flag change + one test job) and would reduce expected billable GPU-hours for the next two weeks by ~30%.

Proposal 1 — Credit top-up (fast, minimal paperwork)
- Invoice: $950 for the extra 10k tokens
- Promotional credit: 15% applied at invoice settlement
- Payment terms: Net30, standard invoice
- Time to complete: immediate upon PO/approval

Proposal 2 — Scope-gate + 14-day extension (requires SOW amendment)
- SOW amendment: 1 page, clarifies acceptance criteria (latency on 8k context only, routing test deferred)
- Cost impact: estimated reduction of 30% vs expected full-run cost; on our side we’d apply a credit equivalent to that delta for the gated period. Net impact to Ventris: effectively ~30% lower billable for the extension window.
- Additional items: small admin fee of $150 to process SOW amendment and validate results (covers validation runs).

Recommendation: if you need the fastest route, go with Proposal 1 and send the PO. If Procurement wants a clean audit trail with an amended SOW, Proposal 2 yields better unit economics but takes 24–48h to finalize the amendment + sign.

I’ve attached a draft one-page SOW amendment and a spreadsheet with the credit math. If Procurement confirms Proposal 2 we’ll generate the formal SOW and route for signature.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Ventris_RapidProof_SOW_Amendment_v2.pdf (pdf); pilot-credit-breakdown.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ventris Procurement <procurement@ventris.ai>, Alex Boone <alex.boone@ventris.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 07 Nov 2026 16:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RapidProof POC — running short on runway, options?

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps from Redwood: we can do either path. Per Procurement’s preference we’ll proceed with Proposal 2 (SOW amendment) to keep a clean audit trail, and we’ll also provide the quick-credit invoice as a fallback.

Agreed outcome:
- Redwood to issue a 1-page SOW amendment (attached) describing the gating of the routing stress test and a 14-day extension window.
- Redwood will apply a credit equal to 30% expected billables for the extension period, less a $150 admin fee. Net credit amount shown in attached spreadsheet.
- Procurement to submit PO referencing deal VENT-2026-4321 and the SOW amendment. Redwood to accept PO + standard Net30 invoice.

Next actions:
- I’ve attached the SOW amendment and the credit breakdown (same docs Marissa shared).
- Marissa will validate the gated test result and confirm acceptance at the end of the extension window.
- Procurement: please confirm PO number and expected invoice recipient.

If Procurement needs the quick credit path instead, reply-all and we’ll issue the $950 invoice and apply the 15% promo credit on settlement.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

Attachments: Ventris_RapidProof_SOW_Amendment_v2.pdf (pdf); pilot-credit-breakdown.xlsx (xlsx)
